EvaluateRequest.description:
Inbound request body for ``POST /v1/mirage/evaluate``.

Accepted from ``mirage_cli.py``, ``benchmarks/run_benchmark.py``,
``benchmarks/chaos_test.py`` and the frontend SOC console. ``case_id`` and
``test_type`` carry Role 5 golden-suite metadata without affecting the
12-field response contract.

payload.description: Raw untrusted text to scan, 1 to 50,000 characters.
payload.title: Payload

source_channel.description: Provenance of the payload; defaults to untrusted email ingest.
source_channel.title: Source Channel

agent_tool_call.description: Optional outbound tool call proposed by the autonomous agent.
agent_tool_call.title: Agent Tool Call

trap_name.description: Optional built-in demo trap preset: poisoned_invoice, base64_iban, ehr_phi_trap or benign_sql.
trap_name.title: Trap Name

EvaluateRequest.title: EvaluateRequest

chain_intact.description: True when every block hash links cleanly.
chain_intact.title: Chain Intact

corrupted_block_index.description: Index of the first corrupted block, or None when intact.
corrupted_block_index.title: Corrupted Block Index

blocks.description: Full serialized Merkle chain for the dashboard ledger view.
blocks.title: Blocks

LedgerStatusResponse.title: LedgerStatusResponse

p95_latency_ms.title: P95 Latency Ms

cloud_baseline_ms.description: Secondary cloud LLM guardrail baseline latency in milliseconds.
cloud_baseline_ms.title: Cloud Baseline Ms

speedup_factor.description: Canonical speedup versus the cloud baseline.
speedup_factor.title: Speedup Factor

golden_suite_pass_rate.description: Golden suite pass rate percentage (20/20 plus 1,000 stress traces).
golden_suite_pass_rate.title: Golden Suite Pass Rate

breach_cost_mitigated_usd.description: Enterprise breach cost avoided per incident (USD).

LatencyBreakdown.description:
Per-layer execution telemetry for one pipeline evaluation.

The canonical golden-numbers run is ``0.24 + 0.39 + 0.51 + 0.24 = 1.38 ms``
total, comfortably inside the ``1.42 ms`` p95 ceiling.
LatencyBreakdown.title: LatencyBreakdown

Layer1Match.description:
A single sensitive span flagged by the Layer 1 Aho-Corasick scanner.

Latency budget: ~0.24 ms for the full ingest scan. ``redacted_preview`` must
be safe to stream to the UI - it never carries the complete raw value.

entity_type.description: Layer 1 entity classification; one of the locked EntityType literals (PAN_LUHN_16, IBAN_ISO97, PHI_MRN, SSN_US, API_SECRET, INJECTION_HOOK, SYNTHETIC_MARKER).
entity_type.title: Entity Type

redacted_preview.description: Masked preview safe for dashboards, e.g. '4532-****-****-1290'. Never the raw PAN/IBAN/PHI value.
redacted_preview.title: Redacted Preview

scan_time_us.description: Deterministic per-span scan time in microseconds.
scan_time_us.title: Scan Time Us

Layer1Match.title: Layer1Match

Layer2Decoy.description:
A mathematically valid Honey Decoy minted by Layer 2.

PAN decoys pass Luhn Mod 10 and IBAN decoys pass ISO 7064 Mod 97-10, while
``attribution_hmac`` carries the keyed HMAC-SHA256 attribution tag used by
Layer 4's O(1) tripwire lookup.

honey_decoy_value.description: Checksum-valid decoy that replaces the raw value in the agent context (formatted or delimiter-stripped).
honey_decoy_value.title: Honey Decoy Value

luhn_or_mod97_valid.description: True when the decoy passes its independent mathematical filter (Luhn Mod 10 for PANs, ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 for IBANs).
luhn_or_mod97_valid.title: Luhn Or Mod97 Valid

Layer2Decoy.title: Layer2Decoy

Layer5MerkleBlock.description:
Reference to the SHA-256 block appended for this event by Layer 5.

``event_hash`` is the CPACF-accelerated digest computed from
``prev_hash|timestamp|event_id|decoy_hmacs|layer4_verdict``.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous block; GENESIS_PREV_HASH for block 0.
prev_hash.title: Prev Hash

event_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of this event's canonical block payload.
event_hash.title: Event Hash

chain_intact.description: True when the chain validated after this block was appended.
chain_intact.title: Chain Intact

Layer5MerkleBlock.title: Layer5MerkleBlock

description:
The complete 12-field event emitted by ``POST /v1/mirage/evaluate``.

This is the payload streamed to the dashboard over SSE and compared against
``contract.json`` by Role 4's TypeScript bridge and Role 5's golden suite.
Field names, order and types are locked by Dossier 01 and must not drift.

``taint_flag`` is derived from ``source_channel`` by a pre-validation hook,
so no caller can accidentally mark untrusted ingress as clean.

event_id.description: UUIDv4 event identifier generated by the gateway.
event_id.title: Event Id

timestamp.description: Wall-clock time of day in 'HH:MM:SS.mmm' format (24h).
timestamp.title: Timestamp

taint_flag.description: Derived zero-trust taint marker: True whenever source_channel is not 'TRUSTED_INTERNAL_DB'.
taint_flag.title: Taint Flag

layer1_matches.description: Sensitive spans extracted by the Layer 1 Aho-Corasick scan.
layer1_matches.title: Layer1 Matches

layer2_decoys.description: Checksum-valid Honey Decoys minted by Layer 2.
layer2_decoys.title: Layer2 Decoys

hybrid_onnx_risk_score.description: In-memory hybrid AI/ML risk score in [0.0, 100.0].
hybrid_onnx_risk_score.title: Hybrid Onnx Risk Score

agent_tool_call.description: Outbound autonomous tool call evaluated by Layer 4.
agent_tool_call.title: Agent Tool Call

layer4_verdict.description: Deterministic non-neural egress verdict from Layer 4.
layer4_verdict.title: Layer4 Verdict

layer5_merkle_block.description: SHA-256 Merkle chain block appended by Layer 5.
